note: Upper bounds for scripts/bench-render.mjs at desktop 1440x900, 300 ticks (30 s), set from 3-run medians on the CI runner (the bench-render job's bench-render-report artifact). --check fails a counter whose median exceeds its budget by more than `tolerance`. A counter named in a scenario's `report` list varies between runs on the runner by more than the tolerance, so it is printed but never fails. Raise a budget in the PR that adds the work, and say why; lower it when a PR removes it.
